content: {"reasoning":"The CO-18 denial states this claim was already adjudicated and PAID. The open balance of $63.02 equals exactly the patient's 10% coinsurance on $630.19. The payer has met its obligation; resubmitting again would only trigger another CO-18 (a process mistake), and appeals/P2P don't apply to a paid claim. The remaining balance is the patient's contractual coinsurance share, so the correct next step is to bill the patient.","action":"bill_patient"}
